title: fsimage 与 edits 日志的 checkpoint 合并
code:
state = {"files": []}
edits = []
def mk(op, name):
    edits.append((op, name))
mk("create", "/a")
mk("create", "/b")
mk("delete", "/a")
fs_files = set(state["files"])
for op, name in edits:
    if op == "create":
        fs_files.add(name)
    elif op == "delete":
        fs_files.discard(name)
print("edits_log:", edits)
print("after_checkpoint_files:", sorted(fs_files))
print("edits_len_before_clear:", len(edits))
edits.clear()
print("edits_len_after_checkpoint:", len(edits))
